resources.string: A little light.\nOnly when it matters.
Automatic keyboard lighting for your Titan 2 Elite.
Connect Shizuku and check the keyboard once. Then enable NightKeys.
Setup is complete. Tap Enable NightKeys to keep automatic lighting running.
A saved change is still pending. Start Shizuku, then tap Stop & restore before trying again.
This phone is not supported yet
This beta is for the Titan 2 Elite on Android 16, in the main owner profile. An ambient-light sensor is required. No hardware changes will be made.
New to Shizuku? The step-by-step guide below explains every tap. No computer or root is needed for wireless setup.
Choose your keyboard brightness in the phone’s own settings. NightKeys keeps that level. The lowest visible level tested was 7; you do not need to enter a number here.
The check stops after 90 seconds. Save the successful check, then tap Enable NightKeys for everyday use.

First choose a comfortable keyboard brightness in phone settings.

In a dark room, begin this check. Wait at least 45 seconds without typing. Lock the screen and watch that the keys stay dark. Wake the phone, then move into bright light.

The check changes only the keyboard timeout and restores the saved timeout afterwards. Do not use the stock keyboard-light tile during the check.
Only select what you actually observed. A setting readback cannot see the physical LEDs.
The keyboard uses my chosen brightness.
In darkness it stays lit for 45 seconds without typing.
After locking, the keyboard stays off, including after a few seconds.
After waking in darkness it lights again, and in a bright room it turns off.
Check saved. When restoration finishes, tap Enable NightKeys.
On below 10 lux. Off at 15 lux.
On below %1$.1f lux. Off at %2$.1f lux.
A lower number means the room needs to be darker. The small gap between on and off avoids flickering near the threshold. Start with 10 lux.
After a phone reboot, start Shizuku again and open NightKeys. Android may prevent automatic restart. Use unrestricted battery mode if your phone pauses the app.

This copies model, firmware, light readings, keyboard timeout and connection status to your clipboard. Nothing is uploaded. Review it before posting publicly. It does not include typed text or a device serial number.
Report copied. Review it before sharing.
NightKeys shows a quiet notification while it manages your keyboard. It includes Stop & restore. Allow notifications in the next prompt.

Before uninstalling, clearing app data or stopping Shizuku, tap Stop & restore. If the app is killed unexpectedly, a persistent keyboard setting can remain changed. This beta has no independent watchdog.
